# Mini Michael Image Library

> Owner-curated transparent Mini Michael illustrations for Mike-authorized content workflows. Use real screenshots instead when the content needs factual or product proof.

- Gallery: https://minimemichael.web.app/
- Full manifest: https://minimemichael.web.app/image-library.json (`/image-library.json`)
- Streaming records: https://minimemichael.web.app/image-library.ndjson (`/image-library.ndjson`)
- Record schema: https://minimemichael.web.app/image-library.schema.json (`/image-library.schema.json`)
- Compatible array: https://minimemichael.web.app/assets.json (`/assets.json`)
- Agent guide: https://minimemichael.web.app/IMAGE_LIBRARY_FOR_AGENTS.md (`/IMAGE_LIBRARY_FOR_AGENTS.md`)
- Live archive status (`assetOverrides`): https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/minimemichael/databases/(default)/documents/assetOverrides

## Agent rules

1. Fetch live `assetOverrides` status first. Exclude every archived document ID and each record whose `duplicateOf` points to it.
2. Default to records where `isCanonical` is true; `duplicateOf` marks exact aliases.
3. Match `useWhen`, `useCases`, `description`, and visual facets—not one keyword alone.
4. Respect `audience`, `tone`, `placement`, `contentTypes`, and `avoidWhen`.
5. Use `absoluteUrl` for the image and `altText` for accessibility.
6. Prefer one semantic image plus at most two accent/signoff images.
7. Mini Michael is mascot art, not proof, photography, or third-party endorsement.
